name: pull-replace-detector
coverage: repeated nearby pull/replace emits only after confirmation threshold is reached
pull without nearby replacement stays silent
single pull/replace without repetition stays silent
heuristic event metadata includes pull_ratio and replacement_speed

notes: SignalId.REGIME_CHANGE is used as the required placeholder marker for heuristic-only DOM events.
Hermes executed pytest with python3 because python was unavailable in WSL.
